clo_details: Understand the basics of the R language
Understand how manipulate data with R programming language and implement fundamental programming tasks
Learn and apply foundational knowledge of the SQL &R languages, and how to access databases from Jupyter notebooks using SQL and R
Know how to wrangle data for data analysis, develop models, improve models, evaluate and tune the performance
Understand how to describe and build graphs using R packages. Implement various types of basic charts to visualize like bar charts, histograms, pie charts, scatter plots, line plots, and box plots
Implement a small data science project includes steps: data wrangling, data analysis, data visualization, model development, model evaluation, and reporting
